Test Order

https://web-workspace.development.getirapi.com/ address can be used for test orders. 

You can't login with the username and password given to you. You must follow the same steps when you sign up to Getir in real life and add an address to your test account. Default OTP login Password: 1234

If you login with masterpass during order, no payment is received in the development environment.

Please do not change the address of the restaurants to proceed correctly. Restaurants are defined in Arnavutköy Mah. so that test couriers can serve.

In order to view the restaurants, you should select your address as Arnavutköy Mahallesi. Otherwise, restaurants will appear as closed.
